notes.title: Build 0390-5586 Patch Notes : DesertTech Rifles/Friendly Healing/Snow Camo
notes.notes:
First order of business- shoutout to everyone that checked out the EXFIL demo over our free weekend. If you were playing, you may have noticed we added several new features to the demo that were not previously present in the retail build. This update adds these features to main game. 

[b]===================================
# BUILD 0390-5586
## Main Branch
===================================[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New weapon: DesertTech SRS bolt-action rifle (long and short variants),
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/83f31f3b919cb919ea525d3789ce38edc27a44fe.jpg[/img]
[*] Secondary (top) sight on some scopes! Use mousewheel to switch when in ADS.,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1cf65387f1eb0e320b280a879ed8c54129f2530f.jpg[/img]
[*] New scope: CQBSS 8x,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/d0ed5c42af096c0d0da52279b909f9b89d2a42b9.jpg[/img]
[*] You can now heal others, press H in front of them if they are injured (this will likely move to the F interaction menu in the future for better UI),
[*] White camo variants for snow ops (or summer if you want to stand out),
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/6a2d889233fcab8e0012b65a6b3931dcc67dd47e.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Edits & Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made VIP visually more distinct.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/d75d9f8be97f4223aaeb834e8263c1f63f81e183.jpg[/img]
[*] Increased GPS maximum zoom to show more of the map,
[*] Improved VIP mode objective highlight on GPS,
[*] Misc optimizations to sound concurrency for bullets and footsteps. General optimization is ongoing.,
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix Helicopter sometimes being the wrong team for some clients on VIP and Seek&Destroy.,
[*] Fix suppressor floating in front of M39 when ADS,
[*] Fix AI targeting friendly drones just after they were deployed,
[*] Don't log bleeding damage as it could make the logs very large,
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game freezing while in spectator view has been reported. This is being looked into.,
[*] VIP mode voice lines are not in yet. We're in the process of recording all new voices.,
[/list]

Lots of exciting stuff being worked on, so stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Major Update Review EA Release to January 2025
notes.notes:
Exfil released on December 11th 2024.

The team of 4 immediately got to work on suggestions posted to our discord.

[h1]Major Additions:[/h1]
[list][b][*] Seek & Destroy Game Mode
[*] Interactive GPS update
[*] Fireteam and Clan Tag callsign selection
[*] New Pistols and Grenade Launcher
[*] AFK Kick
[*] Vote Kick
[*] Other Improvements[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/db04e2069c1329ac48fd116e5521ad352ec74f23.png[/img]

[h1]Game Additions Timeline[/h1]
These changes are a direct result of playing with community, following the suggestions page, and reacting fast to requests.

[b]December 14th:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Auto Kick:[/b] Our players had frustration with AFK team mates, players now get prompted if inactive and are kicked shortly after without response
[*] [b]Vote Kick:[/b] Admins can configure a vote kick system, allowing players to request a kick with reason, and requires a percentage of players to approve the kick
[*] [b]Clan Tags:[/b] Players can now set a clan tag such as [EXFL] Irontaxi, which helps players and admins identify each other when organizing teams
[*] [b]Auto Start Game:[/b] If no admins are present, the game will start a timer at the top of the lobby, counting down to match start, as long as there is more than 1 player present
[*] [b]Main Menu Overhaul:[/b] The main menu received a visual overhaul, improving readability, usability and including some news items for quick reference and links to other sites
[*] [b]Lobby layout update:[/b] Players were unaware of the timer which is now top and center of the page for awareness
[*] [b]Lobby Player count:[/b] Player count is now identified in the lobby in the header buttons Players[Num]. Previously you had to manually count the number of players in the list
[*] [b]Graphics Water Ripples:[/b] When raining the water now reacts more realistically
[*] [b]Server Options:[/b] Ping Attach to player is now an option, some players found it overpowered that a ping would attach to moving players, that can be disabled now, and the ping feature can be entirely disabled[/list]
[b]December 17th:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Check Mags:[/b] Hold R to check magazine capacity, plays an animation and shows UI of magazines at the bottom of the screen
[*] [b]Default Spectate Mode to free cam:[/b] Players were frustrated at being stuck in player POV after death, the default spectate mode now allows players to enter free cam after death, this can be controlled in the match settings
[*] [b]Balancing:[/b] Armor now ricochets bullets and has less damage reduction at point blank ranges
[*] [b]Balancing:[/b] Pistol switch speed increased, it was considered too slow by players[/list]
[b]December 20th:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Spectator:[/b] Spectators can now hear the mission voice lines, helping them keep track of the state of the round whilst free-camming and watching the battle commence[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/424ab54479de46c0fb0d3fbf8b10d96f6b95862a.png[/img]
[b]January 6th:[/b][list]
[*] [b]New Mode Seek & Destroy:[/b] Attackers must destroy one or several targets with C4, whilst defenders must eliminate the enemy team, various match settings for experimentation
[*] [b]Attachments:[/b] Ironsights added for XM7 weapon
[*] [b]Mission VO audio slider:[/b] Players can now control the volume of the mission voice lines
[*] [b]New Pistol:[/b] HK USP, with .45 ACP damage rounds
[*] [b]New Pistol:[/b] HK 45c, with .45 ACP damage rounds
[*] [b]New Pistol:[/b] Glock 22, with .40 S&W damage rounds
[*] [b]New Pistol:[/b] Beretta, with 9mm damage rounds
[*] [b]New Utility:[/b] MK13 Grenade Launcher and Deployable Ammo Bag for MK13
[*] [b]Tracers:[/b] Improved tracer visual effects
[*] [b]Mission VO:[/b] Shortened the 'mission is timed' voice over to be shorter and less intrusive during start of round
[*] [b]Balancing Claymore:[/b] Now includes a 5m radial blast instead of only forward facing damage
[/list]
[b]January 9th:[/b][list]
[*] [b]S&D Mode:[/b] C4 now requires deployment duration, previously it was instant placement which was considered too easy to run and plant
[*] [b]S&D Mode:[/b] When attackers enter range of an objective, they receive a UI prompt on how to equip and place the C4
[*] [b]New Mission Layers:[/b] Seek and Destroy added to Port Lobos and Camp Osprey[/list]
[b]January 13th:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Interaction:[/b] Interactions now show reasons for denied interaction (such as ammo full, helicopter for different team) and includes a scroll list when multiple interactions are possible
[*] [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b]
[*] [b]Bindings:[/b] Drone throttle (raise and lower) can now be bound to mouse[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/611231b46ed58afdad0798a6cebc27cd9875c437.gif[/img]
[b]January 14th:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Range Sandbox:[/b] Several fixes from EA Range integration, now allows players to swap items, grenades and optics correctly[/list]
[b]January 21st:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Simulation:[/b] Ice can now occur on certain maps, allowing traversal across lakes and still rivers changing map dynamics
[*] [b]Full Screen GPS:[/b] GPS can now be entered in full screen (compared to 1 hand only) allowing zoom and pan control of the map
[*] [b]Drone:[/b] GPS now shows a marker on friendly drones, which were previously invisible to GPS
[*] [b]GPS Grid:[/b] GPS now shows gridlines and numbers which help identify what the location numbers relate to and help with callouts to team
[*] [b]New Mission Layers:[/b] Renegade map now include Rogue Mission and Seek and Destroy Mission
[/list]
[b]January 26th:[/b][list]
[*] [b]Fireteams:[/b] Players can now select from 8 fireteams and 32 positions per fireteam in the lobby, and team roster is organized by fireteam/position, allowing organized teams better communication hierarchy, planning and strategy
[*][b]GPS Style:[/b] 2 Hand GPS mode has several pages and Markers have been updated to Unclassified NATO Military Symbology (with some creative freedoms)
[*] [b]GPS Marker Placement:[/b] Players can now place markers in 2 hand GPS mode
[*] [b]GPS Objective List:[/b] Players can now access objective list in 2 hand GPS mode
[*] [b]GPS Callsigns:[/b] Callsigns are visible on player on GPS and their placed markers, allowing you to identify team mates on the map (previously just a colored dot)
[*] [b]GPS Team roster:[/b] Shows your team list with their callsigns, allowing you to cross reference GPS marker callsigns, and to mute player markers if a player is abusing the system
[*] [b]GPS Team chat:[/b] Allows players to chat to their team in during the match
[*] [b]GPS Icon Legend:[/b] Allows players to examine the new NATO symbology and associated meaning
[*] [b]Ballistics Debugging:[/b] Players can toggle ballistics debugging in the Range Map
[*] [b]New Map Layers:[/b] Seek and Destroy now present on all 6 maps across all Points of Interest[/list]
[h1]Whats Next?[/h1]
NPC Factions have been started and exist in the Sandbox Range map for early testing. We continue to iterate each week with the plan to support PvP and PvE NPCs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/3de6bda164f9a4c568e2ddf0a4917fa5aceaf293.gif[/img]
[h2]Initial Plans:[/h2]
[b]NPC Events during PVP missions[/b]
Controlled by match settings[list]
[*][b]Local Forces Patrols:[/b] Patrolling and guarding at the start of a round
[*][b]Local Forces Response:[/b] NPCs will engage with players in the mid to late game, ingress from map borders or via helicopter drop - in particular to push players to action, similar to the existing mortar mechanics
[/list]
[b]PvE missions vs NPCs[/b][list]
[*][b]All Missions:[/b] All existing missions can be played versus an NPC local forces faction, or a shadowy clandestine faction, known only as ....the Vipers! More to come!
[*][b]Territory Control:[/b] Clearing an NPC presence, and holding an AO versus NPC assault
[*][b]Scenario Editor:[/b] Allows players to setup their own round configuration for mission start, objective, and NPC elements
[/list]

notes.title: Week 1 patch notes and Developer Update
notes.notes:
[b]Entry to Early Access[/b]

A huge thanks to our community, publisher Microprose and Development team for countless hours of maintenance, organization and play time during our Early Access entry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/9bad0fa0959b69e0b1574c6f173ea77fa6f393b7.png[/img]

Our commitment to iterative improvements and responding quickly to community continues from pre-release into early access as we play the game with active servers daily, take notes, discuss the game on discord, and update the [i]public-testing[/i] branch.

The public-testing branch is updated several times a week, and we play together with the community to ensure we catch bugs and feedback early. These updates are then packaged together in an update to the main game.

[b]Week 1 Patch Notes[/b]
The main focus that became critical was to smooth out the experience in regards to AFK players in the lobby and in game - who would stop the game from progressing. To tackle this AFK timers, and Vote-Kick features have been added.

We continue to support community hosted servers with a range of match and server settings, therefore the new AFK features have new admin settings to explore.

[list]
[*] AFK timeout configurable by server hosts
[*] AFK vote kick system configurable by hosts
[*] A magazine check system with animation only for m27 and hk416 atm
[*] the lobby will automatically start a timer if no admins are present
[*] A main menu redesign
[*] Match settings to allow pings to attach to players or not (for more hardcore server option)
[*] Players can now set a [Clan Tag] which helps hosts identify groups of players when organizing / balancing teams
[*] Various bug fixes (see Discord Changelog)
[/list]
 
We hope these features help combat problematic players, and enhance and empower you all to foster a positive public server experience.

[b]Join the Discord Community[/b]
The EXFIL Discord is growing with players who share our vision towards creating a [b]realistic infantry combat simulation[/b] with advice and input from both players and veterans.

Whether you are a player looking for a realistic fps (that will never feature hotdog suits and unicorn fart emotes) or you are a military enthusiast or veteran who wishes to join our advisor group - please jump in and find us in discord and in game!

We have a vision to break free of gear fear and overwhelming inventory simulations of recent tactical FPS games. Our goal is to make getting into the boots of a soldier more immediate when you choose to play EXFIL, and to focus on communication, teamwork and military realism.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
AI will be started in January, but first, we have something [i]cooking[/i]...tick tock...

See you in game, Misultin Out.

notes.title: Monthly Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome back folks! [/h2]

Wanted to take some time to update the community on our news for the past month. After an extremely busy Steam FPS fest we have been spending the past few weeks sorting out the bugs and bringing on new team members in our discord. 

We are happy to report some good progress and improvements along the way we want to make sure everyone is aware of! 

[b]Player visibility:[/b] We have improved visibility of teams and at the same time spent some energy on starting to build out the factions identities a bit more. The colourized shoulder armour in testing has been just the right amount of ID needed to minimize Teamkills. We plan to make this is a server side configureable (high vis uniforms) but will use it as the default for now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/b18c5dae37811eb30ebb73b2c2452624837ad8ba.png[/img]

[b]In addition[/b] we have updated all our clan patches and are starting to expand on the story and origins of each faction. Briefly below we have worked on

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/b605860727e1eea032bf516e15071e424627e7a1.png[/img]
[b]Bulls: [/b]North America based Veterans PMC group. Access to the American military complex means lots of gear and the latest weapons. They will be primarily armed with the SIG XM7 platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/026bf3fc78c52d70895cf9379da6fb27335f005d.png[/img]
[b]Dragons: [/b]A mix of Asian and Oceanic countries Soldiers of fortune the Dragons field high tech equipement  and a precision weapons in the HK416 platform and associated variants. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/8eb50036919ab5c55d3451c9644568f22946fc02.png[/img]
[b]Spartans: [/b]Spartans Represent the cream of the crop of European special forces alumni. This experienced and powerful faction chooses to arm itself with MK17 based series and associated platforms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/ab0252024cebfe37eb94097d29318382da5f4c97.png[/img]
[b]Tigers:[/b] Our final faction, The Tigers is comprised of Mercenaries drawn from throughout the east. An experienced faction with cold hard operators they draw their weaponry primarily from the vast patterns of the former soviet union and it offspring, sporting primarily the AK 200 series of weapons and associated gear.

We will continue to update you as the factions evolve. Stay tuned. 


As well here are some of the changes that  have been made/added to the game in the past week or so

[b]Lobby
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/c0a85c58695e10bee46b49c6f1fe4ca64d59e2f1.jpg[/img]
Added a variety of desired functionality including naming, locking server as well as kicking and muting individual players. The lobby also shows you how many people are in the match. This functionality generally extends into the live game now as well where appropriate.   

[b]In preparation for a refactor[/b] and integration of our new weapon sets we have added a variety of prototype scope setups for players to experiment with and test for us. We will continue collecting feedback over the next few tests before making a final decision on our approach. (Note these are on our placeholder weapons still currently but a lot of fun!) 

[b]Iron sights; Red Dot Sight; approx 3x scope[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1749cdd225e5ce33e4cab3977957f95d56e73ed4.jpg[/img]

Some additional additions and improvements

[list]
[*] Refactored Name tags to be high quality UMG widgets. 
[*] Name tags now hide in ADS
[*] Intel Carrier now gets a HUD icon to let them know when they have the good! 
[*] Players list now available in game via menu
[*] Menus now respect the escape key! 
[*] Fixed various night vision bugs
[*] Added a new sandbox game mode so you can jump in a map with out a game mode running
[*] Fixed a variety of issues with radial damage for mortars and grenades
[*] Refactored the spectator pawn as part of future improvements for admins and streamers
[*] Prototyped the RC landdrone with Antitank mine
[*] Added Audio volume at 25% when alt tabbed (as opposed to zero)
[*] Players can see their steam status in the main menu
[*] Added team name to dead cam spectate target
[*] Spectators have a map
[*] Spectators can jump in and out of player views (Arrow keys Left/Right) and free cam (Arrow Up)
[*] Users can define their max FPS for the menus and run time
[*] Fixed shakey tree branches causing blur 
[*] Added a flashlight material for a realistic light cast
[*] Server Host is now marked in the lobby
[/list]
And a whole bunch more!

[b]Finally..[/b] as we prepare for new gamemodes and gear we needed a place to play so we have introduced "The Range" as a WIP playground with a variety of activities and ranges to keep people entertained during down time. We will continue to build out the map and its functional components over the next few months.

notes.title: February Progress update!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back folks![/b]

The team had a glorious break in the month of January but we have been back in the trenches since the beginning of February. Lot’s of work to talk about, news and events coming up. 

Let’s get started!

While its hard to be exhaustive here is a quick run down of some the changes and features that have made it into the game in the past couple weeks. 

Vaulting and mantling is in!  Let the chaos begin! 
https://youtube.com/shorts/klPsCgRnxCQ?si=bvtDIKH5KX7DxzaG

On behalf of the Misultin Team

notes.title: Camp Osprey (map 03) Update

If you are interested in being a tester please join our discord and let us know!

notes.title: Exfil Update Aug 2023
notes.notes:
[b]Hello there friends and followers from the Misultin Team[/b]

Nice to meet you all! (I am new!)

We have a progress update and would like to thank everyone for their continued patience. 

First I’d like to introduce myself, Chris Greig (also known as Irontaxi). I am a long time unreal developer and have worked on a variety of military titles over the years. As a long term development friend of Roberto’s (Misultin's founder) I offered some months ago to come on board and help push Exfil down the path to early access. 

As such.. We have made progress and I will continue to find time to update you on that progress. 

[h2]PORT LOBOS[/h2]

I have spent the past 2 months creating the second map for Exfil Port Lobos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/8e874505a686845070f77e232a7ead6d5db32da2.jpg[/img]

Numerous large POI’s centered around a large port which may or may not be part of a mission objective area depending on the random nature of mission generation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/2d3ff83d1a56f755b3c84c8325c58ecbef89d64a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/15d6fe36e04ae36a58159a4a4e4deac91ca9f385.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1ac9a5050dac3b061f760487b61a006d50c2220f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/64d58ac47dcccd668f419620916bcd5db41d4930.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/9ca57be2e634398d76f0d447d51088858b4608aa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/1f9023ecc9b4916b897e7ac44dba9a782c3286bb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/a5136a299236ce854d7f78ad329b719cefaf643c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33926795/dd65e02d6c21ec3b3e8a40d319ba82719db9d2aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Feature Development
[/h2]
At the same time Roberto has also been chasing and removing nasty little bugs and adding all water-related features such as suffocating (yay!) and various effects. In addition we are testing out a bunch of new features like showing friendlies on GPS, finalizing the Join in Progress feature, adding shootable lights and glass in windows as well as SFX to the radio system. 

Along with these updates and changes we have just restarted the process of testing internally and hope to have more news and videos/screenshots of that in the near future! The feedback from these sessions will be invaluable to giving us a final checklist of features we might want to add before moving to an early access release. 

Keep and eye out for it as we will be recruiting testers in the near future! 

Also feel free to join us on our official discord server [url=https://discord.gg/YZX68Baunv]Misultin Discird[/url]

Cheers!

Misultin Team
